links.comparator_used: Annual labeled model performance (random forest and gradient boosting mortality models) embedded over time, used as the reference for the unsupervised shift clusters; not a head-to-head comparison with periodic audits
links.outcome: Association between unsupervised temporal data-shift clusters and temporal clusters of model performance (in-hospital mortality prediction, MIMIC-IV 2008-2019)
links.effect: Significant association between IGT shift clusters and model performance clusters (Fisher exact test, P<.05); 2 main temporal clusters corresponded to before and after ICD-10 implementation, and the ICD-9 to ICD-10 transition was associated with performance degradation
links.quote: Our results demonstrate a significant relationship between the unsupervised temporal shift patterns, specifically covariate and concept shifts, identified using the IGT projection method and the performance of the random forest and gradient boosting models (P<.05).

design_hint: dataset shift monitoring for drift detection
